name: China
blurb: Official Chinese defense publication, preserved as published: PLA Daily, the Ministry of National Defense and state-linked military outlets.

name: Singapore
blurb: Singapore's Ministry of Defence as a publisher: releases, speeches and records, collected from MINDEF's own site.

name: Regional Security
blurb: Cross-desk analysis of Indo-Pacific security statements and policy. An editorial grouping: it reads from the collecting desks and collects nothing of its own.

name: Archive
blurb: How the record is kept, and where to search it. The archive itself is the production Indo-Pacific Record system.

notice.title: The archive stays where it is
notice.body: This prototype is a publication shell only. The Indo-Pacific Record archive, corpus search and source registry are the existing production system, rendered from the preserved record database, and are not re-implemented here. In this prototype they are reached by link; a later phase decides how the two connect.
